There are 13 total assignments running from Week 1 to Week 13, each available on Tuesday mornings and due the following Sunday at 11:59 pm. Students get five attempts per assignment, with the highest score retained, though incorrect answers result in deductions and quizzes must be completed before restarting. The final homework grade is calculated by averaging the 10 highest scores, allowing students to miss up to 3 assignments without penalty.
